name: Mizumiya Saori
source: [url=/c83148]Ryou's[/url] childhood friend and [url=/c3224]Yuka's[/url] best friend who is a bit of an airhead. Saori is an honor student who easily gets along with everyone and has a kind personality. Her parents own a shrine, where she also works as a shrine maiden and secretly has her own fan club due to this. Saori also has a complex over her breast size and her personality changes when somebody touches her chest.
